scripts.build: npm run sync-version && npm run build:ui && npm run build:sw
scripts.build:source: npm run sync-version && vite build --mode source && vite build --config vite.sw.config.ts --mode source
scripts.build:firefox: npm run sync-version && npm run build:firefox:ui && npm run build:firefox:sw && node scripts/make-firefox-manifest.mjs dist-firefox/manifest.json
scripts.build:firefox:source: npm run sync-version && vite build --outDir dist-firefox --mode source && vite build --config vite.sw.config.ts --outDir dist-firefox --mode source && node scripts/make-firefox-manifest.mjs dist-firefox/manifest.json
scripts.package:source: npm run build:source && node scripts/package-chrome.mjs --variant=source && npm run build:firefox:source && node scripts/package-firefox.mjs --variant=source
scripts.check: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test
